verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only JavaScript source-map upload for de-minifying stack traces. Nothing in it covers uploading dSYM, ProGuard mapping files, or native debug symbols for mobile or native crash symbolication. The Apple Unified Logging module shows an Apple SDK exists, but it concerns telemetry capture, not symbol upload, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload dSYM, ProGuard, and native debug symbols so mobile and native crashes symbolicate to real function names and lines
